verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's own homepage offers its core transaction directly on the site: "Register your entity or get a Unique Entity ID to get started doing business with the federal government." Related docs reference account and workspace pages on sam.gov where registered users manage their accounts. Missing for 10: published step-by-step documentation showing the entity registration completes end-to-end online (including any offline validation steps), and independent or hands-on corroboration of completing a registration.
